authority: Maintainer Generative Semantics Registration G1-G5 directive

G1.space: Ordered anchor pairs within each of the A0, A1, A2 tiers over the registered 21 I4 anchors, evaluated at each candidate office 0 through 6
G1.identity: Office-resolution and witness class, not ledger stateId; state IDs are used only for structural-edge joins
G1.enumeration: Includes diagonal pairs, which both predicates reject; 3 * 7 * 7 * 7 = 1029 candidates, fixed finite enumeration, no heuristic search

G2.T1_a: Symmetric kernel only; office(p) = k-1 mod 7 and office(q) = k+1 mod 7
G2.T1_b: The selected I4 fifth masks have intersection cardinality exactly 5
G2.conjunction: T1_a AND T1_b; no global mask-overlap sweep substitutes for the selected pair check
G2.NC1: Kernel [-2,+1] is not the registered symmetric operator and produces no T1 witnesses

G3.T2_a: Traverse two distinct CONSTRUCTS edges from distinct same-tier parents sharing a child anchor in the next A tier
G3.T2_b: Both traversed edges must match the independently held I1 registered step records by edge ID, parent, child, and parent tier
G3.distance2_provenance: Comes from registered co-parenthood transitions; no office-ring shortcut or mask overlap is invoked
G3.ordered_pairs: Both parent orderings are traversed; neither is silently normalized to T1 orientation
G3.corruption: Non-CONSTRUCTS transitions produce no T2 witnesses, without changing I1 or I4

G4.office_convergence: Office k is generated iff at least one T1 and one T2 witness resolve to k, without requiring identical pair or tier
G4.midpoints: All office-pair structures carried by either route at convergent offices; no selected-only pair output
G4.window_control: The standing T3 window invariant is checked separately over all 49 (j,d) cases. Width 6 invalidates T3-PASS without rewriting the G4 office-membership predicate
G4.mask_control: Non-A-tier or non-anchor provenance prevents an unambiguous T3 assignment
G4.empty_result: Empty convergence is materialized; T3-PASS requires a nonempty unambiguous assignment and the window invariant

G5.stage: Canonical row classification occurs strictly downstream of a complete materialized generation seal
G5.row_resolution: Compare observation office coordinate against primary and secondary witness office coordinates independently
G5.raw_membership: Harness per_state_routes retains raw witness-string membership; it is not substituted for canonical-row classification

harness_encoding.coordinate: Registered Z7 office indices; decimal strings 0 through 6 at the JSON boundary
harness_encoding.ordering: Unique full serialized witness strings sorted by JavaScript code-unit order; no source-order dependence
harness_encoding.generation.t3_assignment: Map from decimal office string to JSON string of the complete sorted unique [tier,[parent_office_p,parent_office_q]] structures
harness_encoding.neutral_encoding_only: Serialization is lossless; ordered parent pairs are never swapped and witness classes are never erased

integer_utility_allowlist.rationale: No named helper is needed by both route call trees; z7 and maskOverlap are T1-private, stepRegistered is T2-private
integer_utility_allowlist.intrinsic_justification: Exact integer conversion only; collection intrinsics may not be shared by route roots

engine_literal_allowlist.array_justification: Exhaustive ascending Z7 coordinate traversal and Z12 mask-bit traversal only; scalar allowlisting does not authorize arbitrary constant tuples
engine_literal_allowlist.integer_justification: Z7 coordinates and interval endpoints (0-7); Z12 bit indices (0-11); symmetric unit offsets; distance-2 overlap cardinality 5; registered three-tier anchor count 21
engine_literal_allowlist.string_justification: Registered A-tier/anchor provenance, registered edge class, and G1 witness route classes; no observed-state identifiers or office-name constants

epistemic_status: G1-G5 are maintainer-registered semantics with receipt-lineage but no independent machine verification at registration time; the pre-flight control suite (NC-1, I2-corruption, NC-3, dissociation matrix) is their first verification, and control-exposed flaws halt for re-registration.
defect_provenance: G1-G5 bridge claim-level definitions with operational engine logic. Prior tooling-only green tests did not verify target semantics and were not reported as a green pre-flight.
